enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust blanket. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and plate. Close cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up bowl and spoon. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in dishwasher. Wipe hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and checking personal phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt, pants, socks. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Press power button. Look at screen. Swipe to unlock. Read messages. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurses station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Adjust IV drip. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to nurses station. Use computer to update records. Answer phone. Talk to doctor. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to patient room. Assist patient with walking. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Return to nurses station. Attend meeting. Walk to patient room. Discharge patient. Walk to nurses station. Update records.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Walk to bedroom. Change out of work clothes.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir fry. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes from table. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start button. Wipe counter with cloth. Wipe stove. Sweep floor. Empty trash. Take out trash. Return to kitchen. Wash hands.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Return to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Use bathroom. Return to living room. Sit on couch. Watch TV.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer and winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to email. Browse internet. Watch video. Turn off computer. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Brush teeth. Walk to bedroom.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust blanket. Sleep.
